title: Comprehensive JWST+ALMA Study on the Extended Lyα Emitters, Himiko, and CR7 at z ∼ 7: Blue Major Merger Systems in Stark Contrast to Submillimeter Galaxies
question: What are the physical origins of the extended Lya emission and UV-bright nature of Himiko and CR7 at z=6.6, probed with JWST NIRCam/NIRSpec IFU plus archival ALMA Band 6 ([CII] and dust continuum)?

data.angular_resolution: continuum beams 0.38" x 0.30" (Himiko) and 0.46" x 0.41" (CR7); uv-tapered [CII] cube 0.94" x 0.81" (Himiko), 0.90" x 0.87" (CR7)

what.value: CR7 NIRSpec IFU line fluxes and physical properties listed for comparison

evidence.quote: We also list the values of CR7 from the literature (cite: marconcini24b).

what.value: Lya spectra of Himiko and CR7 used in the [CII]/[OIII]/Lya spectrum comparison

evidence.quote: and Ly$\alpha$ (blue; (cite: ouchi09; sobral15)) spectra of Himiko (left) and CR7 (right)

what.value: Virial mass from stellar-to-halo mass relation

evidence.quote: The virial mass $M_{200}$ is derived from the stellar-to-halo mass relation (SHMR) in (cite: behroozi19).

recipe.method: Retrieve data from the ALMA Science Archive and calibrate with the archive calibration or pipeline scripts in CASA

recipe.goal: Combine Himiko Cycle 0 and Cycle 1 visibilities

recipe.method: tclean in CASA 6.6.4 with natural weighting; continuum from spectral windows without [CII]; uv-tapered [CII] cube for flux and morphology
Moment 0 maps, sum regions >3 sigma to get total spectrum, sum spectral bins for flux, convert to L[CII]
key_parameters: Noise from 1000 random circular apertures with same size as flux apertures
assumptions: D_L = 65862.5 Mpc at z=6.60 for luminosity conversion

recipe.goal: Derive dust continuum upper limits and IR luminosity
recipe.method: 3 sigma upper limit from noise of continuum maps; L_IR from limit assuming modified blackbody
key_parameters: L_IR over 8-1000 um; T_dust 30-50 K and beta_IR 1.5-2.0 tested

recipe.method: Optically thin dust mass with CMB correction using the 3 sigma flux limit
assumptions: Dust mass absorption coefficient from Dunne et al. 2000, kappa = 0.77 (850 um/lambda_rest)^beta cm2/g
beta_IR = 1.5, T_dust = 40 K (also 35 and 45 K tabulated)

recipe.goal: Estimate molecular/total gas mass and metal mass from L[CII]
recipe.method: H2 mass from the Zanella et al. [CII] relation, total gas mass with metallicity-dependent factor xi, metal mass from gas and dust mass
assumptions: Solar 12+log(O/H)=8.69 and metal mass fraction 0.0134; primordial He fraction 0.2485

recipe.goal: Fit SED of clumps with NIRCam photometry
recipe.method: Prospector SED fitting with FSPS, nonparametric SFH, Calzetti attenuation, Madau IGM, NIRCam photometry (PSF matched, 0.4" apertures); ALMA excluded
key_parameters: log M* in 6-11 (top-hat prior), tau_V in 0-2 (log-uniform), Z=0.2 Zsun
Circular 0.4" diameter apertures (0.5" for CR7-A), no aperture correction
assumptions: Chabrier IMF, Calzetti attenuation, Madau IGM, no AGN component

recipe.goal: Measure emission-line fluxes and direct-method metallicity
recipe.method: Least-squares Gaussian fits to NIRSpec spectra, T_e([OIII]) from 4363/5007 with PyNeb, O abundance from PyNeb
key_parameters: Up to three Gaussians for G395H; number chosen by Delta AIC > 20

recipe.goal: Estimate black hole mass of Himiko-B from broad Halpha
recipe.method: Single-epoch H-alpha relation of Reines et al. 2013 equation 5 with epsilon scaling factor
assumptions: No dust-extinction correction for the broad line
